save_checkpoint: save a fairseq training checkpoint with model state, optimizer, and validation loss to disk
load_checkpoint: load a fairseq checkpoint and restore the training iterator, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
load_checkpoint_to_cpu: load a fairseq checkpoint file to CPU memory with backward compatibility upgrades for older checkpoints
load_model_ensemble: load an ensemble of fairseq model checkpoints for inference with optional argument overrides and task setup
prune_state_dict: prune a model state dict to keep only specified encoder or decoder layers for LayerDrop inference
